name: Swahili Core
orderingNote: Verbs are shown in the infinitive (kusoma), nouns in the singular with their class and plural, adjectives by their stem. Ranks 1-5,000: a blend of term and document frequency over a news corpus, with everyday words that news under-represents inserted by hand; the order is approximate beyond the first couple of thousand words. Ranks 5,001+: dictionary words (English Wiktionary, FreeDict, a published Swahili-English dictionary) attested in a larger corpus (news, web and Bible text), ordered by the same fused frequency rank; the order in this tail is only roughly by frequency. Names and inflected forms removed.
